servinfo.title: Procedure after ECM Replacement

attention3.ptxt: When ECM and BCM are replaced with new ones at the same time, perform “Immobilizer Key Registration” instead of “ECM Registration” using SUZUKI scan tool and security device. Refer to Operator's Manual of SUZUKI scan tool for the immobilizer registration.

servinfo.ptxt: After ECM is replaced with new one, perform the following procedure:

s1.ptxt: Program calibration data to ECM. Refer to Operator’s Manual of SUZUKI ECU Programming System.
Perform electric throttle control system calibration.
